jesügei: Jesügei — Yesügei, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]

temüžin: Temüžin — Temüjin, a boy's name (personal name; Ming (兒名)) [(兒名)]
ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]

ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
olon: olon — many (adjective or quantifier; Ming 多) [多]

töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
ügei: ügei — without, there is not (negative particle) [無]
ökini: ökin — girl, daughter; the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel, read as the accusative, before the reflexive -(i)jen, 'one's own daughter' (noun + case) [女子 自的行]
be: be — particle (perhaps 'he / it is', uncertain; the Ming gives 他 in brackets) [(他)]
ögsü: ög- — to give; optative -sü, 'let it be given, I will give' (verb, optative) [與(呵)]
keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
že: že — particle, 'indeed, so' (the Ming 也者 'so be it') [(也者︀)]
jesügei-baγ̇atur: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei-Ba'atur, Yesügei the Brave, a son's name (baγ̇atur 'hero, brave man') [(兒)名 勇士]

ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]

žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間]
tatar: Tatar — the Tatar, a people (proper name) [(種名)]
qurimlan: qurim — feast, banquet (Ming 筵會); verb-forming -la- + converb -n, 'feasting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [筵會]
büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]
žoluγažu: žoluγa- — to meet, come upon; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
jabužu: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -žu, 'going' (verb, converb) [行着]
kürüġed: kürü- — to reach, arrive; converb -ġed, 'having arrived' (verb, converb, front-vowel form; the stem is inferred from the Ming 到) [到了]
bolžu: bol- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做着]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
irgen-e: irgen — people; dative-locative -e, 'to, among, by' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 行) [百姓 行]
abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
jesügei-baγ̇atur-un: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei-Ba'atur, Yesügei the Brave; genitive -un, 'of Yesügei the Brave' (name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [(人)名 的]

tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般]
ambaγai: Ambaγai — Ambaqai, a man's name (personal name) [(人名)]
qatud: qatun — lady; plural -d (Ming 婦人(每)) (noun + plural; uncertain: whether it names the girl, 'a lady', or stands as a plural, 'the ladies', is not settled; the Ming has no 'of rank') [婦人(每)]
höġelün-üžin: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name (personal name, one two-part name) [婦人名]
kürčü: kür- — to reach, arrive; converb -čü after r, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到着]
köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)]

üžeġed: üže- — to see; converb -ġed, 'having seen' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [見了]
ideküi: ide- — to eat; participle -küi, 'what is to be eaten' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [喫的]
boluba: bolu- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
üge-dür: üge-dür — in the word, in the speech (üge 'word' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [言語 裏]
höġelün: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
bolbi: bol- — to become; past -bi, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
gežü: ge- — to cast aside, abandon, per the Ming; possibly the 'say' verb keġe- in an idiom, uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [撇着]
taičiγ̇ud: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan name, (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [一種(名)]

huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]

irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]

čin-u: či — you; genitive -u on the oblique stem čin-, 'your' (pronoun + case) [你的]
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了]
jorčiba: jorči- — to set out, go (Ming 去; stem inferred); past -ba, 'set out' (verb, past tense) [去了]
irgen-i: irgen — people; accusative -i, 'the people (object)' (noun + case) [百姓 行]
